name: Compare Every Zero
summary: Collect every zero, then solve each matrix cell by measuring its Manhattan distance to every zero and keeping the smallest distance.
visualizationIntent: init: collect all zero coordinates and create an unresolved distance grid. loop: the cell pointer selects one matrix cell while the zero pointer visits every zero. check: compare each Manhattan distance with the best distance so far. update: fix the cell to the smallest distance. return: the completed distance matrix.

lineExplanations.5: Prepare a list of every zero coordinate.
lineExplanations.8: Check whether this matrix cell is zero.
lineExplanations.9: Remember this zero as a distance candidate.

lineExplanations.16: Start at the first column of this row.
lineExplanations.17: Continue until every cell in the row is solved.

lineExplanations.19: Start with the first known zero.

lineExplanations.24: Check whether this zero is closer.
lineExplanations.27: Fix this cell to its smallest measured distance.

syntaxExplanations.1: class Solution: defines LeetCode's required class.
syntaxExplanations.2: def updateMatrix(self, mat): receives the binary matrix.
syntaxExplanations.3: rows = len(mat) stores the row count.
syntaxExplanations.4: cols = len(mat[0]) stores the column count.
syntaxExplanations.5: zeros = [] creates an empty coordinate list.
syntaxExplanations.6: for zr in range(rows): loops through row indices.
syntaxExplanations.7: for zc in range(cols): loops through column indices.
syntaxExplanations.8: if mat[zr][zc] == 0: tests for a zero cell.
syntaxExplanations.9: zeros.append([zr, zc]) records its row and column.
syntaxExplanations.10: big = rows + cols exceeds every possible Manhattan distance.
syntaxExplanations.12: for rr in range(rows): builds each output row.
syntaxExplanations.13: dist.append([big] * cols) adds an unresolved row.
syntaxExplanations.15: while cr < rows: processes every row.
syntaxExplanations.17: while cc < cols: processes every column.
syntaxExplanations.18: best = big initializes this cell's minimum.
syntaxExplanations.20: while zi < len(zeros): examines every zero.
syntaxExplanations.21: zr = zeros[zi][0] reads the zero's row.
syntaxExplanations.22: zc = zeros[zi][1] reads the zero's column.
syntaxExplanations.23: cand = abs(cr - zr) + abs(cc - zc) computes Manhattan distance.
syntaxExplanations.24: if cand < best: tests for a smaller distance.
syntaxExplanations.25: best = cand stores the smaller distance.
syntaxExplanations.26: zi = zi + 1 advances to the next zero.
syntaxExplanations.27: dist[cr][cc] = best writes the final cell distance.
syntaxExplanations.28: cc = cc + 1 advances to the next column.
syntaxExplanations.29: cr = cr + 1 advances to the next row.
syntaxExplanations.30: return dist returns the output matrix.
